title: Book Three · Chapter 104: The Garden Book Returns
story:
The last part of the summer holiday passes.

Ronan keeps the shared money in its envelope. He opens no new book table. The good books stay in one pile and the damaged pair in another.

On the first Monday of term, he sees Anna in the classroom.

“Morning,” he says.

“Morning.”

She puts her bag beside the desk. Lin comes to the door with a question about their new books. Anna goes to look with her.

Ronan takes out his own work. Kai asks him about the football after school.

“Not today. I need to be home by four.”

“The books?”

“One return.”

Kai nods. “Another day, then.”

After the last lesson, Ronan walks straight home. Mrs Deng arrives a little after four with the garden book in her bag.

“My brother brought it back yesterday,” she says.

Ronan opens the back cover. There is the little L mark. He checks the pages with Mrs Deng beside him. They are complete. The book has no new damage.

She points to a picture near the front.

“He has this one already. His old copy is on his kitchen shelf.”

Ronan smiles a little. “A garden in two rooms.”

“One was enough.”

He takes two yuan from the shared forty-three and gives it to her. She counts it, thanks him, and leaves for the fruit shop.

Ronan puts the garden book beside the railway stories. Both have L marks. The other eight saleable books have B inside their covers.

Ten good books now. The two damaged B books stay separate. There are twelve books in the room altogether.

He counts the cash. Forty-one yuan.

On the account sheet, he writes the garden return, the two-yuan refund, and today's date. The promise to Mrs Deng is finished.

Mum comes to put away her sewing basket. She looks at the returned book.

“The right one?”

“Yes. Same mark. All pages there.”

She nods and takes a coat to her chair. Her work continues beside his little pile.

Ronan takes a clean sheet for Leo. He writes the two new totals first: forty-one yuan and ten good books. Then he adds the damaged pair below them.

The first school day has left him tired. He can finish the explanation tomorrow. He puts the sheet with the account and makes room for his homework.

At dinner, Dad asks about the new term. Ronan tells him about the heavier books and Kai's invitation.

“Tomorrow's ball?” Dad asks.

“Maybe. The return is done.”

Ronan puts his school bag beside the chair. His football is waiting in the yard, with the short white mark beside the seam.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

return＝退回；copy＝一本同样的书；complete＝完整的；altogether＝合计、总共。

## 理解问题

1. Mrs Deng什么时候退回哪一本书？Ronan实际退了多少钱？
2. 退书后共同现金、完整书、问题书和实体总数各是多少？

## 读句子

**There are twelve books in the room altogether.**

拆开看：There are / twelve books / in the room / altogether.

有／十二本书／在屋里／总共。
